sr001.e: It says: おべんとうと のみものを もって きて ください. An umbrella isn't needed.
sr001.t: What will the students take with them tomorrow?
sr001.tt:
(At school)
A student saw this notice.

To all international students:
Tomorrow we are going to the mountains. Please come to the front of the school at 8 a.m. Please bring a packed lunch and something to drink. You don't need an umbrella.
Yamada

sr002.e: かいぎの まえに たなかさんに でんわして ください.
sr002.t: What will Miller do first tomorrow?
sr002.tt:
This note is on Miller's desk.

Miller,
Tanaka called. Tomorrow's meeting starts not at 10 but at 11. Please call Tanaka before the meeting.
Suzuki

sr003.e: Today was Sunday, so they got up at 9.
sr003.t: What time did the writer get up today?
sr003.tt: I get up at 7 every morning. But today was Sunday, so I got up at 9. After eating breakfast, I played tennis with a friend.

sr004.t: Can you borrow books at the library at 7 p.m. on Saturday?
sr004.tt:
(This notice is in front of the library.)

Notice from the library
The library is closed on Mondays. From Tuesday to Friday it is open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., and on Saturdays and Sundays until 5 p.m.

sr005.e: Anna buys the drinks; Lee brings food.
sr005.t: What will Lee take to the party?
sr005.tt:
Dear Lee,
Next Saturday I'm having a party at my house. Would you like to come? It starts at 6 p.m. I'll buy the drinks, so please bring something to eat.
Anna

sr006.e: テレビは ありません.
sr006.t: What is NOT in the writer's room?
sr006.tt: In my room there is a desk, a chair and a bed. There is no TV. I often listen to music in my room. There are flowers in front of the window.

sr007.e: かみを かって きて ください (by 3 o'clock).
sr007.t: What does Yamamoto have to do?
sr007.tt:
(At the office)
This note is on Yamamoto's desk.

Yamamoto,
We're out of copy paper. Please go and buy paper by 3 p.m. I'll give you the money later.
Nakamura

sr008.e: ともだちに はなを あげました.
sr008.t: What did the writer give their friend?
sr008.tt: Yesterday was my friend's birthday. I gave my friend flowers. My friend was very happy. After that, we had dinner together at a restaurant.

sr009.t: How long does it take the writer to get from home to the office?
sr009.tt: I go to the office by train every day. From my house to the station it's a 10-minute walk, and the train takes 30 minutes. From the station to the office it's 5 minutes.

sr010.e: きょうしつではなくて ２かいの かいぎしつ.
sr010.t: Where will the test be held?
sr010.tt:
(An email from the Japanese teacher to the students)

Everyone,
There is a test tomorrow. The test will be held not in the classroom but in the meeting room on the 2nd floor. It will be from 9:00 to 9:50. Please bring a pencil and an eraser.

sr011.e: They go to play with the friend's dog.
sr011.t: Why does the writer go to their friend's house?
sr011.tt: I like dogs. But I can't keep a dog in my current apartment. So on weekends I go to a friend's house and play with my friend's dog.

sr012.e: １がつ ４かから また あけます.
sr012.t: From when will the shop be open?
sr012.tt:
(This notice is at the shop entrance.)

Notice
The shop will be closed from December 31st to January 3rd. We will open again from January 4th.

sr013.e: ４じに して ください; えきの まえの きっさてんで.
sr013.t: At what time and where will Kim go?
sr013.tt:
Kim,
We were going to meet at the station at 3 today, right? Sorry, I can't finish my work, so please make it 4. Please wait for me at the café in front of the station.
Sato

sr014.e: There are 5, but the brother lives in Tokyo: 4.
sr014.t: How many people live in the writer's house now?
sr014.tt: There are five people in my family: my father, my mother, my older brother, my younger sister and me. My brother goes to university in Tokyo, so he doesn't live with us now.

sr015.e: The first class is 3rd period, which starts at 10:40.
sr015.t: By what time do the students have to get to school tomorrow?
sr015.tt:
(At school)
A student saw this notice.

Tomorrow's classes
The teacher is off tomorrow, so there will be no 1st or 2nd period classes. Classes start from 3rd period. 3rd period starts at 10:40.

sr016.e: しろい くつの ほうが やすかった.
sr016.t: Why did the writer buy white shoes?
sr016.tt: Last week I bought new shoes. They are white. The shop also had black shoes, but the white ones were cheaper.

sr017.e: れいぞうこの ごはんを あたためて たべて ください.
sr017.t: What will John do about dinner?
sr017.tt:
John,
Today's dinner is in the fridge. Please heat it up in the microwave and eat it. I'll be home late because of work.
Mom

sr018.e: かさを もって いませんでした.
sr018.t: Why did the writer take a taxi yesterday?
sr018.tt: It rained yesterday. I didn't have an umbrella, so I took a taxi home from the station. I usually walk home.

sr019.e: ごはんを たべた あとで.
sr019.t: When should you take this medicine?
sr019.tt:
(At the hospital)
Please take this medicine three times a day, after meals. Please don't take it before going to bed.

sr020.e: わたしの まちには でんしゃが ありません.
sr020.t: What doesn't the writer's town have?
sr020.tt: I rode a train for the first time after coming to Japan. There are no trains in my town. Everyone uses buses and cars.

sr021.e: あした がっこうで かえします.
sr021.tt:
Dear Tanaka,
Thank you for lending me the book yesterday. It was very interesting. I'll give it back to you at school tomorrow. If you find another good book, please tell me.
Maria

sr022.e: ともだちを いえに よんで、いっしょに たべます.
sr022.t: What does the writer always do on Saturdays?
sr022.tt: My hobby is cooking. Every Saturday I invite friends to my house and we eat together. Next Saturday I'm making curry.

sr023.e: きたぐちは つかえません。みなみぐちを つかって ください.
sr023.t: Which part of this station can be used on Sunday?
sr023.tt:
(At the station)
This notice is posted.

Notice
There will be construction work this Sunday, so the north exit of the station cannot be used. Please use the south exit.

sr024.e: If it doesn't rain, 10 o'clock at the park; Lin brings the rackets.
sr024.t: If it doesn't rain, what will Yamashita do tomorrow?
sr024.tt:
Yamashita,
About tennis tomorrow: if it rains, let's cancel. If it doesn't rain, let's meet at the park at 10. I'll bring two rackets.
Lin

sr025.e: けさは パンが なかったので ごはんと みそしる.
sr025.t: What did the writer eat this morning?
sr025.tt: I always eat bread for breakfast. But this morning there was no bread, so I ate rice and miso soup.

sr026.e: しゅくだいは かようびに.
sr026.t: When should the homework be handed in?
sr026.tt:
(An email from the class teacher)

Everyone,
Next Monday is a holiday. There are no classes. Please hand in your homework on Tuesday.
Hayashi

sr027.e: かんじは まだ あまり わかりません.
sr027.t: What does the writer still not understand well?
sr027.tt: I'm studying Japanese. I understand hiragana and katakana well, but I still don't understand kanji very well. I learn five kanji every day.

sr028.e: わたしは ５じの ほうが いい.
sr028.t: Which showing of the movie does Ken want to see?
sr028.tt:
Dear Yoshida,
Would you like to go see a movie tomorrow? An interesting movie is showing at the cinema in front of the station. It starts at 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. I'd prefer the 5 o'clock one.
Ken

sr029.e: In the afternoon they took off the coat: only the sweater.
sr029.t: In the afternoon, what was the writer wearing?
sr029.tt: It was cold today, so I went out wearing a sweater and a coat too. But it got warm in the afternoon, so I took off my coat.

sr030.e: かいぎしつの つくえの うえに.
sr030.t: Where will John put the documents?
sr030.tt:
(An email to John from a coworker)

John,
Please make five copies of the documents for tomorrow's meeting. The meeting starts at 2 p.m., so please put them on the desk in the meeting room by 1.
Kimura

sr031.e: あきの こうえんが いちばん すき.
sr031.t: In which season does the writer like the park best?
sr031.tt: There is a big park in my town. In spring the cherry blossoms are beautiful, and lots of people come. In summer the children play in the pond. I like the park best in autumn.

sr032.e: なにも もって こなくても いい.
sr032.t: What will Nancy bring on Friday?
sr032.tt:
Nancy,
This Friday I'm making Japanese food at my house. Would you like to make it together? I have all the ingredients, so you don't need to bring anything.
Sakura

sr033.e: ノートと ペンだけ かいました.
sr033.t: What did the writer buy yesterday?
sr033.tt: Yesterday I went to the bookstore to buy a new dictionary. But they didn't have the dictionary I wanted, so I only bought a notebook and a pen.

sr034.e: じむしょへ きて ください.
sr034.t: Where should the person who forgot the umbrella go?
sr034.tt:
(This notice is on the school bulletin board.)

Lost umbrella
A blue umbrella was left in the classroom. It is in the office. If it is your umbrella, please come to the office.

sr035.e: いっしょに はしった ことは ありません.
sr035.tt: My older brother gets up at 5 every morning and runs in the park. I get up at 7, so we have never run together.

sr036.e: かりた かさを かえします.
sr036.tt:
Tanaka,
I'm returning the umbrella I borrowed last week. Thank you very much. I'll leave it next to your desk.
Jim

sr037.e: Tuesday as usual; Friday moves to Saturday.
sr037.t: When will the writer swim this week?
sr037.tt: I swim in the pool twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays. But this Friday I'm having a meal with friends, so I'll swim on Saturday.

sr038.e: この かみを もって いって ください.
sr038.t: What do you need to take when you go to breakfast?
sr038.tt:
(This notice is in the hotel room.)

Please have breakfast at the restaurant on the 1st floor. Breakfast is from 6:30 to 9:00. Please bring this paper with you.

sr039.e: わたしは コーヒーを のみました.
sr039.t: What did the writer do at the café?
sr039.tt: Today, on my way home from school, I went to a café with a friend. I had coffee. My friend ordered juice and cake.

sr040.e: えきまで くるまで おくって くれませんか.
sr040.t: What did Lisa ask Park to do?
sr040.tt:
Park,
I'm going to the airport tomorrow morning. Could you drive me to the station? I want to leave home at 7.
Lisa

sr041.tt:
(At the office)
This note is on Lin's desk.

Lin,
Tomorrow's meeting has been moved from the meeting room on the 2nd floor to the 3rd floor. Before the meeting, please set out ten chairs.
Yamamoto

sr042.t: Who does the writer have lunch with on Saturdays?
sr042.tt: Every Saturday I go to a Japanese class. The class is from 10 a.m. to 12. After that, I have lunch with my friends.

sr043.t: What time do classes start on Tuesday?
sr043.tt:
(At school)
A student saw this notice.

Next Monday is a holiday. On Tuesday, classes start 30 minutes earlier than usual. They usually start at 9.

sr044.e: In the morning they go by bicycle.
sr044.t: How does the writer get to the station in the morning?
sr044.tt: From my house to the station it's 15 minutes by bus. But in the morning the roads are crowded, and it takes about 30 minutes. So in the morning I go by bicycle. By bicycle it's 20 minutes.

sr045.tt:
John,
Thanks for coming to the party yesterday. You left something behind: a pair of black gloves. I'll bring them to school tomorrow.
Mai

sr046.t: Where does the cat like to sleep?
sr046.tt: I have a dog and a cat. The dog goes for a walk in the park every morning, but the cat always stays inside the house. The cat likes to sleep by the window.

sr047.tt:
(This notice is in front of the shop.)

Sale
This Friday and Saturday, everything is half price. On Sunday, prices are normal.

sr048.t: How did the writer's dish turn out?
sr048.tt: Yesterday I made a new dish. I made it while looking at a book, but I put in too much salt and it came out too salty. Next time I'll put in just a little salt.

sr049.t: On what day does Kim say he wants to play tennis?
sr049.tt:
Dear Tanaka,
About tennis next week: Wednesday is good for me. But you have your part-time job on Wednesday, right? Then how about Thursday?
Kim

sr050.e: It's near home (and the other one is crowded).
sr050.t: Why does the writer go to the small library?
sr050.tt: There are two libraries in my town. The one in front of the station is big and has lots of books, but it's always crowded. I often go to the small library near my house.

sr051.t: Can you go to the hospital on Saturday afternoon?
sr051.tt:
(This notice is at the hospital entrance.)

Notice
The hospital is open from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. On Saturdays, mornings only. Closed on Sundays.

sr052.t: What does the writer do first in the morning?
sr052.tt: I get up at 6 every morning and run for 30 minutes. Then I take a shower and eat breakfast. I go to the office at 8.

sr053.t: If Sara isn't there, what will Yuri do?
sr053.tt:
Yuri,
We're meeting at the station tomorrow, but my train might be late. If I'm not there, please go into the bookstore in front of the station and wait.
Sara

sr054.t: What does the writer do on Sundays?
sr054.tt: My older brother is good at cooking. Every Sunday he makes dinner for the family. I'm bad at cooking, so I always wash the dishes.

sr055.e: Return it to the front desk.
sr055.t: What do you do with the key when you leave the room?
sr055.tt:
(This notice is in the hotel room.)

Check-out is by 10 a.m. Please return your key to the front desk on the 1st floor.

sr056.tt: It was cold today, so on my way home from school I had some hot soup. My friend ate ice cream. My friend likes ice cream even on cold days.

sr057.t: What does Suzuki have to do?
sr057.tt:
(An email came from a coworker.)

Suzuki,
I'm going on a business trip to Osaka next week. Please buy two shinkansen tickets. It's the 8 a.m. shinkansen on Monday.
Tanaka

sr058.t: What does the writer want to do next month?
sr058.tt: Last month I bought a guitar. I practice at home every night. I'm still bad, but I want to play the guitar for my friend on their birthday next month.

sr059.t: What should people who want to go to Tokyo do?
sr059.tt:
(At the station)
This notice is posted.

Trains are delayed because of the rain. People going to Tokyo, please use the bus. The bus leaves from the west exit of the station.

sr060.e: Under the tree in the park.
sr060.t: Where does the writer often read books?
sr060.tt: My room is on the 2nd floor. I can see a park from my room. There is a big tree in the park, and it's cool in summer. I often read books under the tree.
